description: Call only when the user explicitly asks to flag or report a bad voice turn; never on your own. Saves the last minute of what voice-mcp did (levels, why turns ended, whether speech finished: no transcripts) to a local file. Only works when the user turned the flight recorder on. Returns the file's path.

note.description: Optional: what went wrong, in the user's words.

name: flag
title: Flag a moment
